description: This Java class defines a REST controller for authentication endpoints in a Spring Boot application. It handles user registration, login, token refresh, and logout operations by invoking methods from an authentication service.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for authentication-related endpoints such as register, login, refresh token, and logout.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, returning access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, returning access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens, providing new access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Handles logout by revoking the refresh token.
